title: Structural insights into proteolysis-dependent and -independent suppression of the master regulator DELLA by the gibberellin receptor.
authors: Dahal, Pawan; Wang, Yan; Hu, Jianhong; Park, Jeongmoo; Forker, Karly; Zhang, Zhong-Lin; Sharma, Kedar; Borgnia, Mario J; Sun, Tai-Ping; Zhou, Pei
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜解析GA受体GID1与DELLA蛋白RGA复合物结构，揭示DELLA抑制转录因子IDD的机制，但核心是植物激素信号转导的蛋白-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: The perception of the phytohormone gibberellin (GA) by its nuclear receptor GIBBERELLIN INSENSITIVE DWARF1 (GID1) triggers polyubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of master growth regulators-DELLA proteins-mediated by the SCF(SLY1/GID2) E3 ubiquitin ligase complex. DELLA-encoding genes are known as 'Green Revolution' genes, as their dominant mutations lead to semidwarf cereal varieties with significantly higher yields due to reduced GA response. DELLAs function as central signaling hubs, coordinating diverse physiological responses by interacting with key transcription factors across multiple cellular pathways. While the DELLA domain mediates GA-GID1 binding, the mechanism of SCF(SLY1/GID2) recruitment remained unknown. Additionally, GA-GID1 binding can inhibit DELLA protein activity independently of its proteolysis, although the underlying mechanism was unclear. Here, we present the cryo-EM structures of GA(3)-GID1A complexed with a full-length DELLA protein in Arabidopsis, RGA (REPRESSOR OF ga1-3), and the GA(3)-GID1A-RGA-SLY1-ASK1 complex. We show that the DELLA domain of RGA functions as a molecular bridge to enhance its GRAS domain binding to GID1A through direct interactions with both the GRAS domain and GID1A. Disrupting either intramolecular (DELLA-GRAS) or intermolecular (GRAS-GID1A) interactions weakens RGA-GID1 binding. Contrary to prior models, SLY1 binds the GRAS domain's concave surface without inducing conformational changes. Combining AlphaFold modeling and yeast three-hybrid assays, we demonstrate that GID1 binding to the RGA GRAS domain blocks its interactions with INDETERMINATE DOMAIN (IDD) transcription factors, explaining how GA-GID1 relieves growth suppression independently of DELLA degradation.
abstract_zh: 植物激素赤霉素（gibberellin, GA）由其核受体GIBBERELLIN INSENSITIVE DWARF1（GID1）感知，触发由SCF(SLY1/GID2) E3泛素连接酶复合物介导的主要生长调控因子DELLA蛋白的多聚泛素化和蛋白酶体降解。DELLA编码基因被称为“绿色革命”基因，因其显性突变导致半矮秆谷物品种，由于GA响应减弱而显著提高产量。DELLA蛋白作为核心信号枢纽，通过与多种细胞通路中的关键转录因子相互作用，协调多种生理响应。尽管DELLA结构域介导GA-GID1结合，但SCF(SLY1/GID2)招募的机制此前未知。此外，GA-GID1结合可独立于其蛋白水解作用抑制DELLA蛋白活性，但潜在机制尚不清楚。在此，我们展示了拟南芥中GA(3)-GID1A与全长DELLA蛋白RGA（REPRESSOR OF ga1-3）及GA(3)-GID1A-RGA-SLY1-ASK1复合物的冷冻电镜结构。我们发现RGA的DELLA结构域通过与其GRAS结构域和GID1A的直接相互作用，作为分子桥梁增强其GRAS结构域与GID1A的结合。破坏分子内（DELLA-GRAS）或分子间（GRAS-GID1A）相互作用均会削弱RGA-GID1结合。与先前模型相反，SLY1结合GRAS结构域的凹面而不诱导构象变化。结合AlphaFold建模和酵母三杂交实验，我们证明GID1与RGA GRAS结构域的结合阻断其与INDETERMINATE DOMAIN（IDD）转录因子的相互作用，从而解释了GA-GID1如何独立于DELLA降解解除生长抑制。
